applicability_truth_table.false: Gate false (AcuteDystoniaEpisodePhase NoEpisode with no unknown/missing/conflict) records not_applicable with reason; claims no posterior and is never a negative finding or a fake negative review posterior.
applicability_truth_table.true: Gate true (AcuteDystoniaEpisodePhase Active or Resolved with all other required inputs known) executes estimation with empty evidence; airway Present still executes and adds a parallel urgent banner.
applicability_truth_table.unknown: Gate unknown (any required input unknown, not_assessed, missing or conflicting, including missing onset, medication-timeline, alternative-cause, differential, safety or preference context) yields needs_clarification before estimation; never coerces uncertainty to false and never estimates.

input_consistency_contract.dx_provenance: Full Acute Dystonia Dx Criteria item responses (addx_sustained_posture, addx_medication_timeline, addx_distribution_persistence, addx_exclusions, addx_urgent_airway) are preserved with definition version, completeness and nullable results when the complete reviewed source is available; Dx supports measurement and its items alone never establish a summed score. Completion is required only when episode phase is Active; NoEpisode and not_assessed have no completion requirement; a missing Dx item never becomes a negative finding.
input_consistency_contract.gate_inputs: Episode phase plus airway, association, safety, age-vulnerability, burden, recurrence-need and preference inputs define true/false/unknown; unknown, missing, not_assessed or conflicting required input pauses, never coerces to false and never coerces to Absent.
input_consistency_contract.history_review: Candidate v1 definitions require owner review before release. No runtime form or projection added by S36.
input_consistency_contract.missingness_scope: These declarations are content proposals for the S40 projection/readiness implementation, not executed clinical runtime behavior.
input_consistency_contract.severity_provenance: Acute dystonia severity is an independent clinician-reviewed mild, moderate or severe category recorded with examination and window attribution; it is never derived from a Dx total and no summed severity band or treatment threshold is set here. No dose, route, frequency, active/stopped or free-text fields are collected or accepted.
input_consistency_contract.urgent_inputs: AirwayConcern (stridor/breathing difficulty, laryngeal dystonia) comes from saved structured urgent inputs with encounter/window attribution; the parallel urgent banner does not wait for estimation, while the AirwayConcern network node remains estimation context for AcuteDystoniaReviewPathway.

missingness_contract.absent_rule: An absent case (AcuteDystoniaEpisodePhase NoEpisode with no unknown/missing/conflict) records not_applicable with reason and claims no posterior; never a negative finding and never a fake negative review posterior.
missingness_contract.alternative_context: Missing onset, medication-timeline, antipsychotic-association, alternative-cause, differential, anticholinergic safety, age-vulnerability, burden, recurrence-need, preference or airway context pauses as needs_clarification; missing context is never treated as an established-association or no-concern finding.
missingness_contract.current_urgent: AirwayConcern Present (stridor or breathing difficulty suggesting laryngeal dystonia) renders an urgent banner from saved structured inputs in parallel with review topics, independently of estimation latency; never a computed risk percentage.
missingness_contract.gate_definition: Gate true requires AcuteDystoniaEpisodePhase Active or Resolved (present/resolved episode) with all other required inputs known; gate false is AcuteDystoniaEpisodePhase NoEpisode (absent case) with no unknown/missing/conflict among required inputs; otherwise gate unknown (including unknown, not_assessed, missing or conflicting).
missingness_contract.not_assessed_rule: An unresolved or not_assessed effect (unknown, not_assessed, missing or conflicting required input, including missing onset, medication-timeline, alternative-cause, differential, safety or preference context) pauses as needs_clarification; never coerced to Absent and never mapped to No. A missing Dx-criteria item never becomes a negative finding.

numerical_tolerances.row_total: exact integer units; never normalize or repair

reference_cpts_status: Synthetic mathematical references only; all 12 BN-11 distributions were missing and remain uncalibrated with no source lookup; no clinical calibration or approval

resource_limits.memory_limitation: Existing bounded child process/node/table limits do not establish an OS memory ceiling or bound every induced intermediate factor. No such memory admission claim is made.
resource_limits.overflow_policy: Reject admission or fail explicitly; no truncation, approximation or incomplete-table fallback.
resource_limits.status: Candidate engineering limits; existing inference limits preserved, provider capability not yet measured
